title: Emergency router restart – Sydney Metro nbn Enterprise Ethernet and vNNI services
current_summary: We have scheduled an emergency router restart at our Eastern Creek (2SYB) site between 12:00 am and 1:00 am AEDT on Tuesday 24 November 2026. Some nbn Enterprise Ethernet services connected through the 2BLK and 2SYB POIs, and vNNI services in the Sydney Metro area, may be disrupted for up to 20 minutes during this window.

cause.reason: Emergency router restart at the Eastern Creek (2SYB) site

updates.content: We will carry out an emergency router restart at Eastern Creek (2SYB) between 12:00 am and 1:00 am AEDT on Tuesday 24 November 2026. During this time, some nbn Enterprise Ethernet services connected through the 2BLK and 2SYB POIs, as well as vNNI services in the Sydney Metro area, may be disrupted. Affected services may be offline for up to 20 minutes. We will update this notice if anything changes.
